name: routism-social
description: Routism Social — social media publishing and scheduling platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,dashboard -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w apps/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w apps/dashboard
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w apps/dashboard
